content_sections.heading: ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR NBSSLUP Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 13 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available for various posts including Project/Field Assistant, Supporting Lab Staff, IT Assistant, Project Assistant, Technical Assistant, and Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the posts in ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month, depending on the post and qualifications of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for applying to ICAR NBSSLUP posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for applying is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from a Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Engineering to a Post Graduate degree in Remote Sensing/Geo informatics. Specific details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ICAR NBSSLUP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Nagpur, Maharashtra, 440033.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).
